THE “JUST ONE MORE QUESTION” CORNER

Curious?
Good.

It’s kind of the whole point.

Ask the organizers ↗there are no silly questions. ⤴
Who can take part?

The programme is for school students across grades 6–8th / 9–12th, with teams of 2–5 students. The proposed categories are Junior (classes 6–8) and Senior (classes 9–12). Schools nominate or register participating teams.

Is the event online or on campus?

The aptitude test and idea pitch rounds take place online. Shortlisted finalists present live on the MNIT campus in Jaipur. Exact dates and venue details will be announced.

What should we prepare for the final?

The draft format is a 7-minute team pitch followed by 3 minutes of questions. Prepare a 16:9 PPT and PDF backup covering the problem, solution, users, value and execution. Final deck specifications will be shared by the organizers.

What happens after the Ideathon?

The winning team receives a structured mentorship and incubation track. Codevidhya supports promising ideas with refinement, project development and connections to relevant startup ecosystems.

When does registration open?

Registration is open now. Teams can register on the registration page; it takes about 5 minutes. Exact dates and the final challenge theme will be announced by the organisers.

Is it free?

Fee details will be shared by the organisers. For updates, write to headoffice@codevidhya.com.
